chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام was brought the case of a bathhouse keeper with whom clothes had been placed, then they were lost, so he did not hold him liable, and he said:

key_terms.أَمِينٌ: a trustee, one entrusted with property
key_terms.الثِّيَابُ: the clothes that had been deposited with him
key_terms.صَاحِبِ حَمَّامٍ: a bathhouse keeper or attendant entrusted with customers' belongings
key_terms.يُضَمِّنْهُ: to hold him financially liable for the loss

ai.seo_question: Is a bathhouse keeper liable if deposited clothes are lost?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when clothing deposited with a bathhouse keeper was lost, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام did not impose liability upon him. The ruling is based on the principle that such a person is regarded as a trustee, not automatically responsible for loss without proof of wrongdoing or negligence.
